_help.how_to: Copy this file to pregame.json in your working folder and replace every placeholder (YYYY-MM-DD, HH:MM, Opponent) and the example values with what the user told you, then run: python SKILL_DIR/scripts/fetch_game.py --validate pregame.json (SKILL.md, pre-game step 1, manual path). --validate exits 3 while a placeholder is still in place. Record only what the user said; never invent a time or a rink.
_help.competition: FCAA, or another competition name as the user gives it (III-divisioona games come from fetch_game.py --next instead)
_help.date: ISO date of the game, today or later; replace the placeholder YYYY-MM-DD
_help.time: face-off time, 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. 21:00); replace the placeholder. Ask the user if unknown: the time is the point of the post
_help.weekday: optional three-letter weekday, e.g. SUN; --validate warns when it does not match date. Leave it empty to use the weekday of date
_help.arena: rink name as the user gives it (e.g. Kaarela 1). Ask the user if unknown
_help.us_side: home or away, as the user says. Ask the user; never guess from the rink name. The post is green for home and orange for away
_help.home / away: name of each team; is_us true for Näädät, false for the opponent. Replace the placeholder name Opponent. Swap the two blocks and set us_side to away for an away game. Näädät keeps the name Näädät
_help.logo_file: opponent logo file (PNG/JPG), a real file from the user or the club, path relative to the folder that holds pregame.json (just the file name when it sits next to it). Remove the key if there is no logo: the script then draws a lettered badge
